name: summon-4-pi
description: 对话悬浮窗 Summon — a hotkey-summoned chat window for PI-Desktop that drives a real host session (Agent mode, with attachments) or a quick chat with local read tools and web search.

scripts.vendor: npm run vendor:morphicons && npm run vendor:curve
scripts.verify: npm run test && npm run test:vendor && npm run lint && npm run renderer:check && npm run design && npm run check
scripts.verify:release: npm run pack && npm run verify:package

comment: No "type": "module" on purpose — the plugin's main.js is CommonJS, and a root-level type:module would make Node treat it as ESM. tools/*.mjs are ESM via their extension.
